stories.title: Courts shield AI prompts and outputs from discovery
stories.simple_summary: Courts are deciding that when people use AI systems in legal cases, the things they type into AI (called prompts) and the answers AI gives back don't have to be shared as evidence.
stories.why_it_matters: If you ever get involved in a lawsuit, this might protect some of your private conversations with AI tools — but this is mainly a legal issue that doesn't affect daily life.

stories.title: DeepSeek raises API pricing for its V4 models
stories.simple_summary: DeepSeek, a company that makes AI tools, is charging more money for people who use their newest AI models.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use DeepSeek's AI tools for your business, your costs will go up — but most small businesses use other AI tools like ChatGPT, so this might not affect you.

stories.title: How Artificial Intelligence Disrupts Engineering Progression
stories.simple_summary: An article discusses how AI is changing the way engineers do their work and plan their careers.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly relevant to engineers and people hiring them — not something most small-business owners need to worry about right now.

stories.title: Anthropic Said in Talks to Buy Startup Decart for $6 Billion
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic, a big AI company, is thinking about buying a smaller company called Decart for $6 billion.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Why Japanese firms are being so slow to use AI
stories.simple_summary: Japanese companies are slower than Western companies to start using AI in their businesses.
stories.why_it_matters: This is interesting news about business trends, but doesn't change anything about how or whether you should use AI.

stories.title: Some Claude users are mad that Anthropic’s new watermarks will catch them using it at their jobs, classes
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic (maker of Claude AI) is adding hidden marks to text that Claude creates, so people can tell if something was written by the AI — and some people are upset because their bosses or teachers might catch them using AI when they shouldn't.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Claude at work or school and try to hide it, this makes that riskier — but if you're using AI honestly and telling people about it, this doesn't affect you.

stories.title: Amazon will train on Twitch streamers’ content by default, unless they opt out
stories.simple_summary: Amazon has decided it will automatically use videos from Twitch streamers to teach its AI, unless streamers say no first.
stories.why_it_matters: If you stream on Twitch, your videos will be used to train Amazon's AI unless you specifically go into settings and turn it off.

stories.title: AI was supposed to destroy jobs. Where’s the carnage?
stories.simple_summary: An article questions whether AI has really destroyed jobs the way many people predicted it would.
stories.why_it_matters: This is interesting to think about, but it's mainly analyzing trends — it doesn't tell you what will happen to your job or business.

stories.title: AI coding startup Cognition reportedly already in talks to raise at $40B valuation
stories.simple_summary: Cognition, a startup that uses AI to help write computer code, is trying to raise more money at a very high value ($40 billion).
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: As AI safety concerns mount, three pioneers make the case for staying open
stories.simple_summary: Three famous AI experts are discussing whether AI should be kept open for everyone to use, or controlled more carefully, and how America can stay competitive with China.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about big policy and business strategy — not something that affects what you do with AI today.

stories.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raises $2B to bring AI to the enterprise
stories.simple_summary: A company called Thrive Holdings just raised $2 billion to build AI tools for businesses to use.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it doesn't change anything about AI tools available to you.

stories.title: Twitch streamers can now opt out from training Amazon’s AI
stories.simple_summary: Twitch is now letting streamers choose NOT to have their videos used by Amazon to train AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you stream on Twitch, you now have the option to protect your content from being used by Amazon's AI — and you should check your settings to do this if you want to.
